basics.name: Jose Miguel Rosas Jimenez
basics.role: Tech Lead | Software Architect | Full Stack Developer
basics.bio: Full Stack Developer, Tech Lead, and Software Architect with over 5 years of experience leading engineering teams, designing scalable architectures, and developing production-grade web and mobile applications. Specialized in robust backends, AI Agents and intelligent Chatbots integration, cross-platform mobile apps, and cloud deployments on AWS.

devops_cloud: AWS (EC2, ECS, S3, IAM, App Runner, SNS, Polly, Transcribe)

experience.description: Technical leadership of the Digital Health and Artificial Intelligence division. Architecture design, software engineering, and AI agents integration for occupational health ecosystems (RedVive+).
Engineering team leadership, scalable architecture design (Hexagonal) with Node.js and NestJS, CI/CD pipelines in AWS with Docker, technical mentoring, and strict Clean Code reviews.
Full stack enterprise web development with Node.js and NestJS, database performance tuning, and payroll microservices.
Founder and lead developer of enterprise software solutions using NestJS, Vue.js, AWS, Docker, AI Agents, and relational / NoSQL databases.
Technology research, innovative prototype development, Linux server administration, and AWS cloud deployments.
Frontend and backend web development using React.js and Node.js; relational database management with SQL Server.

services.title: Software Architecture
services.description: Design of scalable, maintainable architectures for web and mobile systems. Design patterns, separation of concerns, stack selection, and growth strategies.

services.title: AI Agents & Chatbots
services.description: Development of advanced virtual assistants and autonomous agents capable of reasoning and task execution. Integration of LLMs (Gemini, GPT) with enterprise data (RAG) for WhatsApp and Web.

services.title: Backend Development
services.description: Building robust, secure APIs with Node.js and NestJS. JWT authentication, role-based access control, external integrations, Redis caching, and relational/NoSQL databases.

services.title: Frontend Development
services.description: Modern, responsive, high-performance interfaces built with Vue, Nuxt, Tailwind CSS, and Bootstrap. Focus on UX, speed, and clean code maintainability.

services.title: Full Stack Applications
services.description: End-to-end software development from backend architecture to polished frontend interfaces, ready for production with Clean Code and solid standards.

services.title: DevOps & Cloud (AWS)
services.description: Application deployment and infrastructure management on AWS (EC2, ECS, S3, App Runner) with GitLab CI/CD. Dockerization, Nginx reverse proxies, and Linux environments.

services.title: Technical Mentoring & Leadership
services.description: Engineering team mentorship, rigorous code reviews, coding standards definition, and guidance in key architectural decisions.
